messages:
nina: Heads up 10: SigmaCloud + BuildForge want a co-sell playbook for our Satellite adapters (LangChain + LlamaIndex). Request: marketplace listing + partner demo + joint announcement. Need a checklist and owners. Who can lead ops, docs, and legal?

james: I can coordinate ops + billing. Need SKU, pricing guidance, and marketplace metadata by next week.

alex: technical lead here. Major items: manifest spec, compatibility matrix, test harness for index loaders, and hardware tags for optimized images. I can draft manifest today.

maria: partnerships: partner expects a 3-week runway. Also wants logos, boilerplate, and a short case study template for BuildForge. I'll own partner comms.

samir: BuildForge wants a reproducible demo runbook (terraform + infra profile) and perf baselines for small/medium/large. I can create two Cloud configs and an automated script. ETA 2026-04-02.

loretta: I'll draft the blog outline + social snippets. Need partner quotes and a couple of customer-facing screenshots. Send assets to me by 2026-04-06.

dor: product note: we should include a recommended routing policy example for OrchX (latency-first vs cost-first) and a short guide for fallback policies when dedicated capacity is low. I can draft the UX copy.

legal-bot: Quick legal flags: co-marketing MSA addendum + logo usage agreement required; data usage for demos must be synthetic or consented. We'll target 48-72h review once we get draft assets.

james: ops question: marketplace requires an entitlements map (features enabled per tier). Alex, can you enumerate capabilities for the manifest (embeddings/chat/tool-calls/rerank)?

alex: yes. Proposed manifest snippet: 

```json
{
  "connector": "satellite-langchain-lidx-v2",
  "compat": ["langchain>=0.2.0", "llamaindex>=0.6.1"],
  "capabilities": ["embeddings","chat","rerank","tool-calls"],
  "optimized_images": ["sigma-a100-rtx:quantized-v2"],
  "test_matrix": ["cpu-small","gpu-medium","gpu-large"],
  "version": "2026-04-07"
}
```

alex: and a quick smoke test command to run locally: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/adapter/test -d '{"connector":"satellite-langchain-lidx-v2"}'`

maria: marketing asks: can we get a 30s demo clip and a 1-page cheat sheet for partners? Samir, can you capture the clip during perf runs?

samir: yes. I'll record a short demo and include timings. Also adding a script to reproduce results in under 10 minutes.

loretta: social copy draft idea: "Redwood x SigmaCloud: seamless orchestration for LangChain & LlamaIndex adapters. Ship faster, scale cheaper." Will refine with partner quotes.

legal-bot: Also flag: if SigmaCloud wants co-branded marketplace badges we need an approval flow in the agreement.

james: ops checklist so far: SKU & pricing plan, entitlements map, billing contract template, release window, and revocation procedure. I'll draft a one-pager and share.

dor: monitoring: include observability dashboard links and recommended SLOs (p95 latency < 200ms for small model). Who owns dashboard templates?

alex: eng infra can provide dashboards. I'll open a repo with Grafana JSON + Console route docs.

deploy-bot: Staging slot booked 2067992000. Prod release window tentatively 2067992400-2067992600.

nina: Good progress. Summary of owners: James -> ops/billing + SKU; Alex -> manifest + tests + dashboards; Samir -> demo + perf; Maria -> partner liaison + logos; Loretta -> comms + blog; Dor -> UX + rollout guides; Legal -> agreement review. Please add any missing items and ping if any blockers.

james: one blocker for billing: need to confirm revenue share for Marketplace listing. I'll loop in finance after this thread.

maria: partner asks about joint webinar during co-sell week. Who can present technical deep-dive? Alex + Samir?

alex: yes, happy to present architecture and demo. Samir will run the live demo.

nina: ok locking this plan. Quick sync Weds 09:30 PT to validate artifacts. Thanks all :rocket:
